F01.title: Real Angular hydration was NOT enabled; corrected and now proven
F01.previousState: S5-V asserted only ng-version/ng-server-context presence as a proxy for hydration. In fact the server injector had no hydration DOM-reuse flag, so no ngh annotations were emitted and the client RECREATED the app instead of hydrating.
F01.rootCause: ngh annotations are emitted by ɵannotateForHydration only when ɵIS_HYDRATION_DOM_REUSE_ENABLED is true in the SERVER injector. SsrAppModule provided only ServerModule, so the flag was unset. Using provideClientHydration(withEventReplay()) on the server ALSO fails, because the event-replay feature's client-only providers prevent server-side annotation.
F01.fix: Added provideClientHydration() (WITHOUT withEventReplay()) to SsrAppModule.providers in packages/angular/tests/ssr/ssr-server.module.ts (test fixture only). Client keeps provideClientHydration(withEventReplay()).

evidence.serverHtml: 4x ngh="0" annotations plus <!--nghm--> content-integrity marker present
evidence.clientLog: Angular hydrated 4 component(s) and 9 node(s), 0 component(s) were skipped
evidence.nodeReuseProof: hydrate-server.mjs injects a blocking inline script that stamps data-server-node on app-ssr-shell, #plain, and #plain enhanced-select at parse time; hydrate-client.ts compares those node identities before bootstrap and verifies the stamp survives after whenStable(), setting window.__serverNodesReused = true

F01.verdict: CONFIRMED — genuine hydration + node reuse, no NG05xx warnings

F02.title: Tag collision hides the real widget — GENUINE ADAPTER DEFECT (previous 'benign' classification retracted)
F02.previousState: S5-V used a programmatic container.click() inside page.evaluate() and concluded 'benign / no visible artifact'. That click bypasses visibility/hit-testing and therefore masked an invisible, un-usable widget.
F02.mechanism: The <smilodon-select> host is upgraded by core's NativeSelectElement, whose constructor does attachShadow({mode:'open'}) and appends only _listRoot (role=listbox) + _liveRegion (role=status). There is NO <slot>. The light-DOM <enhanced-select> (the real widget) is therefore NOT composed into the rendered shadow tree and is not painted.

measurements.controlExperiment: cloning the SAME <enhanced-select> into a plain div renders at 48x1264 — the widget itself works; the slotless foreign host shadow suppresses it
measurements.focus: the combobox INPUT is tabIndex:0 but readOnly:true and offsetHeight:0; .focus() does NOT move document.activeElement -> real focus impossible

F02.verdict: GENUINE ADAPTER DEFECT — the S5-V 'benign' claim was WRONG. Preserved as reproduction; NOT remediated (production remediation requires separate authorization).
F02.preservedAs: Three Playwright tests marked test.fail() (expected failure while F02 is open; a loud unexpected-pass if it is ever silently 'fixed'): 'tag collision does NOT hide the real widget', 'collision does NOT suppress layout', 'REAL focus cannot reach the widget (F02 consequence)'.
